verdict.rationale: Luma's own llms.txt states that the Luma API ships Python/JS/TS SDKs, so official SDKs are a first-party claim. However, it is a single summary line, with no SDK reference, package names, install steps or usage examples in the pack. The piapi.ai API mentioned by a community member is third-party and earns no credit. Missing for 10: SDK documentation (package names, install and usage guides, method reference), SDK coverage of the current Agents API versus the legacy Dream Machine API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Luma API: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
